<module id="adder_pipe_64bit">
    <description>64-bit Ripple Carry Adder with Pipeline Stages.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock input.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="i_en">Enable signal for addition operation.</input>
        <input id="adda" width_description="[63:0]">64-bit input operand A.</input>
        <input id="addb" width_description="[63:0]">64-bit input operand B.</input>
        <output id="result" width_description="[64:0]">65-bit output representing the sum of adda and addb.</output>
        <output id="o_en">Output enable signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        Always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                // Reset all registers to zero
                reg_a <= 64'd0;
                reg_b <= 64'd0;
                carry_in <= 1'b0;
                sum_reg <= 65'd0;
                o_en <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                if (i_en) begin
                    // Load inputs into registers
                    reg_a <= adda;
                    reg_b <= addb;
                    carry_in <= 1'b0; // Initialize carry_in for the first stage
                end

                // Calculate sum for each pipeline stage
                sum_reg[0] <= reg_a[0] + reg_b[0] + carry_in;
                carry_out[0] <= sum_reg[0][6];
                for (int i = 1; i < 64; i++) begin
                    sum_reg[i] <= reg_a[i] + reg_b[i] + carry_out[i-1];
                    carry_out[i] <= sum_reg[i][6];
                end

                // Update output enable signal
                o_en <= i_en;
            end
        end

        // Assign final sum and output enable signal
        result <= {carry_out[63], sum_reg};
    </implementation>
</module>
